sentences.japanese: 違法駐車で２０ドルの罰金を科せられました。
sentences.english: I was fined 20 dollars for illegal parking.

sentences.japanese: もし君がここに駐車していたなら、罰金を科せられていただろう。
sentences.english: If you had parked your car here, you would have been fined.

sentences.japanese: ケンはスピード違反で７千円の罰金を科された。
sentences.english: Ken was fined 7,000 yen for speeding.

sentences.japanese: オニユリはユリ科に属する１つの種である。
sentences.english: Tiger lilies are one species of the lily family.
